about: Canonical system health (src/system_health.build_artifact), written daily by evidence_refresh.yml. overall: FAIL if any RED check or protected_tracks_modified; WARN if any AMBER/NO_DATA; PASS otherwise. Every status comes from the rule stored beside it.
